relations: As the flanking moving-head fixtures tilt and pan, their faces flare bright white in alternating bursts before fading to darkness.
The central starburst's horizontal arms narrow and soften while vertical rays persist, keeping the dark core locked at the center.
The floor's smooth blue beam wash breaks into scattered pools as discrete white oval patches emerge and drift near the bottom edge.
The bright mark above the core maintains its central position while the surrounding rig cycles through flares and beam sweeps.
caption: A dark, mirror-symmetrical concert lighting rig fills the frame, viewed head-on. At its center a black X-shaped core radiates blue beams upward, downward and outward, with a small bright mark set just above it. Columns of moving-head fixtures flank the rig, their truss-mounted blue light streaks tilting and panning continuously. The fixture faces flare bright white in alternating bursts, then fade to darkness as they re-aim, so the side arrays shimmer with shifting points of light. Meanwhile the horizontal arms of the central starburst narrow and soften, while the vertical rays persist and the dark core stays locked at the center. On the floor, a blue fan of projected beams spreads outward, and discrete white oval patches emerge and drift near the bottom edge, breaking the earlier smooth wash into scattered pools. The framing stays broadly fixed, keeping the outer rig and floor in view, yet the bright mark holds nearly the same central position throughout. The rig therefore keeps cycling through its flares and beam sweeps without resolving into a finished state.
